fn step(n: Int) -> Result(Int, Int):
    return Err(0) if n == 0
    return Err(1) if n == 2
    Ok(n + 10)
fn execute() -> ():
    for value in 0..4:
        defer println(value)
        with
            number <- step(value)
        do
            println(number)
        else
            Err(0) -> continue
            Err(1) -> break
            Err(_) -> return ()
        println("after")
    println("finished")
fn main(): execute()

fn fallback(source: Result(a, Int), otherwise: a) -> a:
    with
        value <- source
    do
        value
    else
        Err(_) -> otherwise
fn forward(source: Result(a, e)) -> Result(a, e):
    with
        value <- source
    do
        Ok(value)
fn main():
    println(fallback(Ok(1.25), 2.5))
    println(fallback(Err(1), "fallback"))
    let good: Result(Int, String) = Ok(4294967296)
    println(Result.unwrap_or(forward(good), 0))
    let failed: Result(Int, String) = Err("bad")
    match forward(failed):
        Ok(value) -> println(value)
        Err(error) -> println(error)

    println("auth")
    if ok: Ok(7) else: Err(AuthError("denied"))

    if ok: Ok("done") else: Err(LoadError(5))

    with
        id <- auth(ok: auth_ok),
        text <- load(id, ok: load_ok)
    do
        text
    else
        Err(AuthError(message)) -> message
        Err(LoadError(code)) -> "failed {code}"
fn main():
    println(execute(auth_ok: true, load_ok: true))

    println(execute(auth_ok: true, load_ok: false))

    println(List.get(Map.keys(updated), 0))

    println(Map.len(deleted))
